request.style: English, rootsy folk, male vocal with group harmonies, acoustic guitar, mandolin, fiddle, upright bass, foot stomp, swinging, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Early in the morning, the landowner went
To hire some workers, a denarius was meant
At the third hour, at the sixth and the ninth
He went to the marketplace, he called them in line

[Verse]
At the eleventh hour some were standing around
Why have you been standing here idle all day
Because no one has hired us, the men all replied
You also go into the vineyard, he said with a smile

[Chorus]
So the last will be first
And the first last
Grace is not wages
Grace is a gift that holds fast

[Verse]
When evening came, they lined up for pay
The last ones got a denarius for one hour of the day
The first ones grumbled, we bore the scorching heat
Friend, I am doing you no wrong, take what is yours and eat

[Chorus]
So the last will be first
And the first last
Grace is not wages
Grace is a gift that holds fast

[Bridge]
Am I not allowed to do what I want with what is mine
Or are you envious because I am generous

[Outro]
So the last will be first
And the first last
